subject: Request: Encryption & key-management artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review
messages:
From: Elena Mora <elena.mora@acme.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2028-05-27 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Encryption & key-management artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Grace,

Acme is onboarding Redwood for our SIG/SOC2 review this quarter. As part of the encryption section we need a compact package of artifacts that demonstrates your KMS/HSM controls and key rotation practices. Can you provide the following within 3 business days?

- Key rotation schedule and policy (preferably the last 12 months of rotation events)
- Export of rotation logs (machine-readable CSV) covering May 2027–Apr 2028
- HSM attestation(s) for any root/wrapping keys (vendor-signed)
- Diagram of KMS topology (regions, root/wrapping separation, BYOK flow)
- Confirmation of at-rest encryption algorithm/parameters (cipher, key sizes)
- Proof of access control for KMS (roles with access & audit trail)

We will accept encrypted bundles via your secure upload or a signed S3 presigned link. If there's a standard attestation template your legal/security team prefers, please include it.

Thanks,
Elena Mora
Security Operations — Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

(Attached: Acme_Request_EncryptionChecklist_v1.pdf)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mora <elena.mora@acme.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-27 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Encryption & key-management artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a compact evidence package and deliver on your 3-business-day window. Plan below:

1) Delivery contents (encrypted .tar.gpg): rotation-log CSV, HSM attestation PDF, KMS topology diagram (SVG/PDF), access-control matrix (CSV), short attestation letter signed by Redwood SOC team.
2) Delivery channel: we prefer a HubSpot secure upload link or an S3 presigned object (encrypted transit + server-side e2e). Please confirm which you prefer.
3) Clarification: do you need raw key material (root key export) or only signed attestations and rotation metadata? We do not export private key material for security reasons; attestation and signed timestamps are what we can provide.

Irene and Karthik — can you prepare the rotation log extract and HSM attestation artifacts, and bundle them with the checklist? I will handle the attestation letter and secure upload.

Attaching: acme-evidence-checklist.md (draft) — will replace with final bundle.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Security Programs — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
(attachment: acme-evidence-checklist.md)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-28 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Encryption & key-management artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Grace / Karthik — preparing bundle now. Deliverables being generated:

- rotation-log-202705-202804.csv (filtered to Acme tenant events)
- hsm-attestation-thales-202803.pdf (vendor-signed copy we keep on file)
- kms-architecture-202805.svg (diagram)
- access-control-matrix-acme.csv (role IDs redacted)
- acme_evidence_bundle_20280527.tar.gpg (encrypted payload)

Note on approach: the rotation CSV contains timestamp, key_id (hashed), rotation_type (scheduled/ emergency), initiating_principal (redacted id), and signature token. Example lines (redacted):

# timestamp, key_hash, rotation_type, initiator, signature
2027-06-12T02:14:07Z, 0x9f3a...f2, scheduled, redacted-user-118, SIG:abcd1234
2027-11-08T15:05:22Z, 0x4b7c...a7, emergency, redacted-user-004, SIG:ff12e9b3

HSM attestation note: the attached vendor PDF includes an HSM serial, firmware hash, and vendor-signed SHA256 chain. We will not include private key material in any transfer. The tarball is encrypted with our public key and will be delivered via HubSpot secure upload link. I will send the decryption passphrase to Elena via a verified phone call after upload.

Outgoing attachments (attached to this message for internal record): rotation-log-202705-202804.csv (redacted), hsm-attestation-thales-202803.pdf, acme_evidence_bundle_20280527.tar.gpg

Irene
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
(attachments: rotation-log-202705-202804.csv; hsm-attestation-thales-202803.pdf; acme_evidence_bundle_20280527.tar.gpg)

Subject: Re: Request: Encryption & key-management artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Grace / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few quick items to close out: 

- HubSpot upload link works for us. Please upload the encrypted bundle to the REQ-8821 folder and post the link here.
- When you send the passphrase by phone, please also include the PKCS#7 timestamp (or a DocuSign-signed attestation) so we can chain the evidence into our CAIQ/SIG package.
- For the HSM attestation, can you include the vendor chain and the FIPS mode statement (if applicable)? The Thales PDF you mentioned should be sufficient if it has firmware hash + signing chain.

If you can confirm upload by EOD tomorrow we will mark this as satisfied in our tracker and close the outstanding item.

Thanks again — we appreciate the level of detail.

Elena
Security Operations — Acme Corp
